2608.04001.title: Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning LLMs: Inference Regimes, Evaluation, and Reproducibility
2608.04001.paper_summary: Large language models can solve substantially harder reasoning problems with more inference-time compute. The term "test-time scaling," however, now covers diverse inference algorithms that extend deliberation along a single trajectory, sample completed candidates and aggregate them through voting or verification, or search over unfinished partial states. These algorithms differ in their statistical structure, compute accounting, and failure modes. Treating these procedures as interchangeable under a single scalar "budget," or reporting accuracy without the inference protocol that produced it, makes results difficult to compare across studies. We develop a systematic account of test-time scaling along three axes. First, we formalize test-time scaling as budgeted inference over the implicit prefix tree of an autoregressive model and distinguish three structural regimes: single-trajectory sequential scaling, leaf-level scaling with terminal reduction, and prefix-level scaling. Second, we treat the evaluated object as the entire inference system and develop evaluation principles that separate end-to-end system performance from candidate-bank diagnostics. We introduce an evaluation profile whose coordinates and simple functionals recover or bound common repeated-sampling metrics, and prescribe protocol-matched reporting of compute and uncertainty. Third, we specify reproducibility requirements for inference protocols, distinguishing exact replay from distributional reproducibility and identifying the artifacts needed to support each. We also organize the open-weight reasoning ecosystem by model-side and interface mechanisms, apply these principles to broad-knowledge, symbolic-reasoning, and competition-mathematics benchmarks, and assemble over 2 billion full reasoning traces for release with progressively richer verifier and token-level signals.
2608.04001.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型可以透過更多的推理時間計算來解決實質上更困難的推理問題。 然而，"測試時間擴展"這個術語現在涵蓋了多種推理算法，這些算法沿著單一軌跡擴展深思，抽樣完成的候選者並通過投票或驗證進行聚合，或在未完成的部分狀態上進行搜索。 這些算法在其統計結構、計算核算和失敗模式上有所不同。 將這些程序視為在單一標量"預算"下可互換，或在未提供產生準確性的推理協議的情況下報告準確性，會使得不同研究之間的結果難以比較。 我們沿著三個軸線發展了一個系統的測試時間擴展說明。 首先，我們將測試時間擴展形式化為對自回歸模型的隱式前綴樹的預算推理，並區分三種結構範疇：單軌跡序列擴展、具有終端縮減的葉級擴展和前綴級擴展。 其次，我們將評估對象視為整個推理系統，並發展評估原則，以將端到端系統性能與候選銀行診斷分開。 我們引入了一個評估配置文件，其坐標和簡單函數能夠恢復或界定常見的重複抽樣指標，並規定與協議匹配的計算和不確定性報告。 第三，我們為推理協議指定重現性要求，區分精確重放與分佈重現性，並識別支持每一種所需的工件。 我們還根據模型端和介面機制組織開放權重推理生態系統，將這些原則應用於廣泛知識、符號推理和競賽數學基準，並組裝超過20億個完整的推理痕跡，以便釋放具有逐步豐富的驗證者和標記級信號。
